name: Ranka
title: Houndmistress
examine: Keeps the fort's hounds — the line bred down from Bern's dog, the one that came back across the ice. She talks to them in full sentences and to people in most of one.
lines: They are not pets. They are colleagues with better hearing.
Bern's dog swam back through broken ice. Everything in that pen remembers it in the blood.
If a hound of mine does not like you, I want to know why before you leave.
